summary: Divider component that renders a horizontal or vertical separator line. This component is used to visually separate content sections. (Package docs; Coin has no designer guide for Divider.)

examples.purpose: A horizontal separator between two sections.

props.name: direction
props.description: Direction of the divider line. - 'horizontal': renders a horizontal line (default) - 'vertical': renders a vertical line. Default "horizontal", from the component source.

props.name: modes
props.description: Mode configuration passed to the token resolver.

props.name: style
props.description: Optional style overrides for the divider.

modes.name: Color Mode
modes.description: A token collection Divider reads (the package's FIGMA_COMPONENT_MODES). When modes leave it unset, the resolver uses the collection's default mode.
